complexity.rationale: The piece draws conclusions across model attribution, account access, privacy and physical feedback, requiring bounded evidence and clear operational caveats.

sourceCoverage.rationale: Nine timestamp cues span creator device baseline, models, tool permissions, privacy, sponsorship, physical feedback and experimental limits. Source navigation remains approximate.

supportingArgument.rationale: The article develops the permission, attribution, privacy and feedback distinctions from the creator demonstration without claiming independent replication.

evidenceRoles.rationale: Creator narrative, platform policies, product documentation, local ASR navigation and GhostMesh interpretation are separated by source role.

counterargument.rationale: A functioning hobby demonstration can be useful without proving durable permission enforcement, physical recovery or representative real-world performance.

tradeoffs.rationale: A low-cost conversational robot offers accessible prototyping while account delegation, privacy, background recording and physical feedback expand operational risk.

falsifiability.rationale: Repeat specified voice and tool tasks with revoked send rights, false wakes, latency, noisy motor recovery and defined stop conditions.

originalSynthesis.rationale: The bounded thesis separates sensor observation, local routing, remote model services and authority to act, with physical feedback as an additional system constraint.

performance.rationale: No reproducible benchmark of model quality, wake latency, false positive rate, authorization bypass resistance or physical reliability was conducted.

economics.rationale: The low robot acquisition cost does not establish the cost of safe operation, secure account integration or ongoing maintenance.

threatGovernance.rationale: Private ReasonPack media and ASR stay off the public site; custody confirms source bytes, not compliance, permission or implementation correctness.

ownerDecision.approval: I approve merging ghostmesh-readers PR #173 at exact head be6e04e88c6c815bb27f38933d8fed5814c3f10c, following the required independent review, and publishing Reader #61. Subsequently: Okay, approve, get it done.

gaps.rationale: Local Whisper transcription and approximate cue navigation are not certified word-for-word or a full independent audiovisual review.
Native iPhone rendering and production deployment are not yet verified; desktop preview was owner reviewed.

decisionRationale: Independent editorial acceptance covered exact authored manuscript and public evidence boundaries. Owner explicitly approved publication, while new source-custody and receipt metadata require fresh exact-head merge authorization before protected merge.
